Figure 1. (A) High-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC)
profile of the metabolites of A. violaceofuscus CBS 115571. The
chromatograms were monitored at 280 nm. (B) Structures of

ung cluster. MFS: major facilitator superfamily transporter; AR:
alanine racemase.

indicates the site of hydrolysis by UngD.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. (A) LC-MS analysis of D-DLA derivatives of the enzymatic
reaction products of UngC and L- and D-alanine. The chromatograms
were extracted at m/z 384.150 ± 0.025. (B) HPLC profiles of the
metabolites from the gene deletion mutants of A. violaceofuscus. The
chromatograms were monitored at 280 nm. (C) HPLC profiles of the
enzymatic reaction products of UngD. The chromatograms were
monitored at 280 nm. (D) LC-MS analysis of the metabolites from A.
oryzae transformants.
